title: 强调句
explanation:
## 强调句:It is/was + 被强调部分 + that + 其余

强调句用于突出句子的某个成分(主语、宾语、状语),结构为 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他部分。去掉 It is...that 后句子仍然完整,这是判断强调句的黄金法则。

## 基本用法

原句:Tom met Mary in the park yesterday。

- 强调主语:It was Tom that (who) met Mary in the park yesterday。
- 强调宾语:It was Mary that Tom met in the park yesterday。
- 强调地点状语:It was in the park that Tom met Mary yesterday。
- 强调时间状语:It was yesterday that Tom met Mary in the park。

## 与定语从句的区别

It is the book that I bought yesterday(定语从句,book 在从句中作宾语)vs It was the book that I bought yesterday?去掉 It is...that 后,"the book I bought"不完整,这是定语从句。强调句去掉框架后句子仍完整。

## 特殊强调

1. 强调 not...until 结构:It was not until midnight that he came back。
2. 强调句型与疑问句结合:Was it you that broke the window?Who was it that called?

examples.en: It was in 2018 that he graduated from college.
examples.cn: 他是在 2018 年从大学毕业的。
examples.note: 强调时间状语 in 2018,去掉 It was...that 句子仍完整。

examples.en: It is the teacher who always encourages us.
examples.cn: 正是这位老师一直在鼓励我们。
examples.note: 强调人时可用 who 代替 that。

examples.en: It was not until midnight that he finished work.
examples.cn: 直到午夜他才完成工作。
examples.note: 强调 not...until 结构,固定搭配 It was not until...that。

examples.en: It is English that he studies at school.
examples.note: 强调宾语 English,去掉框架后 he studies English at school。

errors.wrong: It was yesterday when he came back.
errors.right: It was yesterday that he came back.
errors.note: 强调句中固定用 that,不用 when。

errors.wrong: It is because he is ill so he is absent.
errors.right: It is because he is ill that he is absent.
errors.note: 强调原因状语用 that,不用 so。

errors.wrong: It was at the station which he saw the accident.
errors.right: It was at the station that he saw the accident.
errors.note: 强调地点状语固定用 that,不用 which。

quiz.q: It was in the library ___ I found the book.
quiz.note: 强调地点状语用 that,不是 where。

quiz.q: ___ was Tom that won the first prize.
quiz.note: 强调句固定以 It 开头。

quiz.q: It was not until dark ___ he realized the danger.
quiz.note: not until 强调结构用 that。
强调主语 I 时,谓语与 I 一致,用 am。

quiz.q: It was the rain ___ delayed our flight.
quiz.note: 强调主语 the rain,用 that。
